newsitem.title: FINLAND: GOVT WILL NOT CUT MUNICIPAL GRANTS MORE - LIPPONEN.
newsitem.headline: GOVT WILL NOT CUT MUNICIPAL GRANTS MORE - LIPPONEN.

text.p: Finnish Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen said on Tuesday the government would not make any new cuts in state transfers to municipalities in the 1998 state budget.

"The government does not intend to make any new cuts in state transfers to municipalities," Lipponen told reporters after a meeting between himself, Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto and leaders of the Association of Local Authorities.
But earlier government decisions on cuts in state transfers to local governments affecting 1998 would remain in force, Lipponen said.
The coalition government is scheduled to agree on February 25 on the budget expenditure frames for 1998-99.
